item.title: Rubbish and weeds, 25th July
item.description:
The triangle garden between Sutlej Rd and Marlborough Lane is full of rubbish. There has been no clearing for weeks. The recent gas pipe repairs made the situation worse when people threw rubbish over the plastic barriers. The gas people also flattened some of the plants in the triangle. (They also mixed concrete on our drive and promised to clear it up, but didn't. I wrote the company and got no reply, and spoke to two employees at the time with no result.)
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Sutlej Road, Charlton
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Very uneven paving outside 68/70 Temple Fortune lane, 25th July
item.description:
The paving outside of 68and 70 Temple Fortune Lane is becoming increasingly uneven with several stones protruding by more than 2.5cm. This is a significant trip hazard on a pavement that is used extensively to access the health centre and Finchley Road shops/ cafes. This has been an issue for some time but is getting significantly worse. I am concerned for my safety as I have to regularly use this area and I am 76 years old.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Temple Fortune Lane, Temple Fortune, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
